name: Logitech CollabOS - Device Monitoring
description: Monitors Logitech CollabOS-based video conferencing devices (e.g. Rally Bar, Rally Board) via the device's local REST API with token-based authentication. Retrieves device configuration, device insights (state, mic, speaker), room insights on CollabOS 1.15+ (dynamically discovered), and connected peripherals (dynamically discovered).

others: Logitech CollabOS device REST API accessible over HTTPS (port 443)
Room insights variables are only available on CollabOS 1.15 and later
Peripherals and room insights variables are created dynamically from the API response, so the total variable count varies by device and number of connected peripherals
